data.action: 穿着舒适的舱内机能便服，大口享用双球甜筒冰淇淋，赤红眼眸微微弯起，黑角与恶魔尾巴惬意晃动
data.description: 【莱瓦汀 · 冰淇淋时间】休息区明亮的冷饮自动贩卖机前，莱瓦汀举着超大号的三球抹茶草莓冰淇淋甜筒，两只金红色的眼眸闪闪发亮，头顶的红角随着兴奋轻轻抖动——「哈！大战一场之后大口吃冰淇淋简直是世上最棒的享受！管理员，你要不要也尝尝这一大口？超级过瘾！」
data.location: 塔罗斯-II 研究基地物资舱
data.promptProse: Laevatain raises a three-scoop matcha-and-strawberry ice-cream cone before the rest area's cold-drink vending machine, her gold-red eyes bright and red horns tilted with excitement. Her black halter top, cropped gray techwear jacket and utility skirt remain in medium view. Machine panels overlap the wall behind her. Bright industrial canteen light illuminates the scoops and metal buckles, with a compact cone shadow across her hand.
data.title: 莱瓦汀 · 塔罗斯补给·冰淇淋的双重享受
